phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: What exists is recorded, the repo has a real test harness, and known security gaps are closed.
phases.exitCriteria: On a clean clone, `npm ci && npm run check && npm test && npm run build` pass, and a user cannot read another user's order or payment. (CI moved to the backlog on 2026-10-23, D-012.)

features.name: Baseline: record current services, routes, events and known gaps as the starting point
Test harness: Vitest across packages, wired into `npm test` and `npm run check`, first unit tests
Ownership checks on `GET /orders/:id` and `GET /payments/:orderId` (users see only their own data)
Spec dashboard: local Next.js app showing roadmap, feature progress and memory, live
Dependency upgrades to latest stable, Dependabot, JSDoc on every file and export, coding standards

phases.title: Checkout & Assistant
phases.goal: Checkout completes end to end through the saga, and the AI assistant reaches its planned feature set.
phases.exitCriteria: An order placed in the UI reaches `CONFIRMED` (or `CANCELLED` with a reason) without manual steps, and the assistant eval suite passes its agreed target on the configured model.

features.name: Saga payloads: align `inventory.reserved` with the payment consumer so checkout reaches `CONFIRMED`
Assistant: store policies in the prompt and human handoff via Kafka (design doc Phase 3)
Assistant: eval suite, answer feedback and usage analytics (design doc Phase 4)

backlog: Protect product write routes (admin role check at the gateway or in product-service).
Shared rate limiting (the gateway limiter is per process, in memory).
Assistant: compaction for long conversations (`assistant.interaction` events are in 012).
Assistant: per-user daily token budget (design doc §6; deferred from 012 Q12).
Update the HLD/LLD `.docx` guide with the assistant service, then regenerate `doc_extract.txt`.
Server-side price lookup when adding to cart (the cart currently trusts the client's price).
Server-side prices when creating an order (the order total is computed from client-sent prices; 000 G8).
`order.shipped`: nothing produces it and notification has no handler (000 G9).
Durable idempotency for the order and notification Kafka consumers (000 G10).
Fresh clones start unprotected: generate `INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN` in setup or refuse to start without it (000 G11).
Services type-check against the built `packages/shared/dist` (type declarations since 2026-10-24, D-029), so shared must be built before their typecheck (found in 001; matters for CI).

CI: GitHub Actions running check, test and build on every push and pull request (was Phase 0 feature 003; moved to backlog 2026-10-23, D-012). Needs Node 26 and `shared` built before the service typecheck.
Persist Kafka data: the `kafka_data` volume is commented out in `docker-compose.yml`, so recreating Kafka wipes topics and consumer offsets (found in 010; 010 makes the saga robust to it).
Gateway circuit breaker: the gateway has none (`opossum` was installed but unused; removed in 005, D-031). Add one if a slow service should fail fast.
Gateway rate limiter is mounted before `/health`, so a busy client (or scripted tests) makes the gateway's health check return 429 (found in 010 verify).
Order list shows "0 items": `GET /orders` returns orders without their items, and the storefront counts `order.items` (found in 010 T034).
